newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber market closed for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber market closed for Christmas.

text.p: The Singapore rubber futures market was closed on Wednesday for the Christmas Day holiday. The market was also closed on Tuesday for a trading holiday. It will reopen on Thursday.
On Monday, the April/June RSS3 contract settled at 130.50 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 130.75 cents.
The April/June RSS1 contract settled at 183.75 Singapore cents (US$1.31) a kg from the previous 184.25 cents.
The February TSR20 contract settled at 171.75 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg from 172.25 cents.
